title: Parks - Property
description: Status: UPDATED occasionally using ArcMapContact: Jennifer Psillas, City of Tucson Parks and Recreation Department, 520-837-8025, Jennifer.Psillas@tucsonaz.govIntended Use: For map display of the physical boundaries of parks and area estimates of park land maintained by the COT Parks and Recreation Department.Known Errors or Qualifications: Area calculations are approximate and have not been field verified.Supplemental Information: Park locations were compiled from several shapefiles in the Pima County GIS Library including: cotparc, park_all (no longer available), and paregion. Locations were also compiled from shape files provided by Jim Robinson - TDOT. The source shapefiles are based on the Pima County tax parcels and represent the legal boundaries of the parks. Additional park area located in ROW or land without a tax parcel id was added by digitizing the physical boundaries of the park from aerial photography in order to determine the "real world" extent of the park. All locations were reviewed by Tucson Parks and Recreation Department staff. Park locations consisting of multiple tax parcels were dissolved to create a single polygon in most cases. Some parks are represented by multiple polygons. These instances are generally due to either to the park being too large to display at a legible scale on a single 8.5x11 page (see JOHN F KENNEDY PARK) or the park has multiple parts that are separated by areas that are not owned or maintainted by the COT Parks and Recreation Department (See LA PLACITA PARK). In order to get accurate summaries of park assets by park, run the "Summarize" function on the LABEL_1 field.Lineage: Circa- July 2010 created by Norris Design, 418 N. Toole Ave, Tucson AZ 85701, Phone (520)622-9565 using ArcMapAttributes:MAP_ID = unique ID # - Naming consists of a L + a 3-digit number. LOCATION = Data Driven Page name. This field corresponds to the field of the same name in the PARK_Asset_Polygons_ layers. It is an index for the pages. Some large parks (i.e. JOHN F KENNEDY PARK) have been have multiple "locations" to allow them to be displayed on an 8.5 x 11" sheet at a legible scale.LABEL_1 = Park Name. USE THIS FIELD TO SUMMARIZE ASSETS BY PARK.LABEL_2 = Label_1 in sentence caseALIAS_1 = placeholder for alternate names for parks if applicableALIAS_2 = placeholder for alternate names for parks if there is more than one aliasADDRESS = Address. If the park does not have an official address, then use the nearest CLASS = Park type based on categories defined in the 2006 Parks and Recreation Ten-Year Strategic Service Plan. Additional categories were added for properties that did not fit into any of the defined categories. These include cemetery plots and undedicated/undeveloped properties.USE = Defines the intended use of the property (Aquatics, Cemetary, Golf, Park, School, Transportation, Undeveloped)WARD = COT Ward numberDISTRICT = TPRD District nameOWNER = Property ownerMANAGER = Organization responsible for maintenance of the property.AREA_FT = Area measured in square feetAREA_ACRES = Area measured in acresACRES_TEXT = Area in acres for layout textMB_INDEX_A = Data Driven Page index with LOCATION only. Use as "Name Field" in Data Driven Pages setup menu.MB_INDEX_B = Data Driven Page index with DISTRICT and LOCATION. Use as "Sort Field" in Data Driven Pages setup menu.MB_SCALE1 = Sets the scale for data driven pages for an 8.5 x 11" page . Use as "Data Driven Scale" in Data Driven Pages setup menu.MB_ROTATE1 = Sets the rotation for data driven pages for an 8.5 x 11" page . Use as "Rotation" in Data Driven Pages setup menu.SOURCE = Organization responsible for collecting the dataREVDATE = Date of last revisionMB_DETAILS = LABEL_1 + CLASS + ACRES_TEXT. PARKING = Estimated parking capacity. Data carried over from the PARK_Asset_Polygons_Parking _Lots layer. PATH_DIST = Estimated loop walk distance. Data carried over from the PARK_Asset_Loop_Centerlines layer.
